info.name: NoviCloud SDK - Test Collection
info.description:
Test collection for NoviCloud REST API v2.10.

## Collection variables
- base_url: https://system.novicloud.pl/rest/api
- account: account name
- username / password: Basic Auth credentials
- created_id: auto-set by POST script (save_id_ev)
- created_kod: auto-set by POST loyalty card
- stanymag_orig_ilosc: original quantity before PUT stanymag

## WARNING - production server
POST/PUT sequences always end with DELETE or restore.
For stanymag: run 'GET BEFORE' as the first step of the PUT sequence.
For loyalty cards: no DELETE - cleanup = set uniewazniono field.
